entries.answer: Install, inspect, test, and repair electrical and electronic systems on transportation equipment (motor vehicles, rail vehicles, ships, aircraft, and more): read circuit diagrams and work orders, measure with instruments and locate faults, replace or adjust components, perform preventive maintenance and keep records, then retest and submit for release confirmation by an authorized role.
entries.question: What do electrical and electronics installers and repairers for transportation equipment mainly do?

entries.answer: This occupation focuses on electrical and electronic systems on transportation equipment; electricians focus on installing building electrical systems and code compliance; electronic equipment installers and repairers for motor vehicles focus on vehicle electronic accessories and systems. subject.name: Electrical and electronics installers and repairers, transportation equipment
subject.summary: Under U.S. O*NET-SOC 49-2093.00, install, inspect, test, and repair electrical and electronic systems on transportation equipment (motor vehicles, rail vehicles, ships, aircraft, and more): read circuit diagrams and work orders, measure with instruments to locate faults, replace or adjust components, perform preventive maintenance and keep records, then retest and submit for release confirmation by an authorized role.
